The structure of Li2Mo6O14 (reduced formula LiMo3O7) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 22 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mo centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Li centers have four O neighbors and O centers adopt either tetrahedral or octahedral coordination. The polyhedra connect through corner- and edge-sharing contacts, including Mo–Mo octahedra sharing corners and edges and Li–Mo tetrahedra sharing corners, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
